verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM's self-hosted/local-first design (data stays on device, cloud/external services are opt-in) gives users inherent control over where data lives and by extension the ability to delete it via their own infrastructure, and admin controls/multi-tenant isolation suggest some data governance. However, there is no explicit documentation of retention policies, data export, or in-app deletion/purge features for chats, embeddings, or vector stores. Missing for 10: explicit deletion/retention UI or API documentation, data lifecycle policy statements, independent confirmation that deletion actually removes data from vector stores/logs.
